echo ""

print(f\"awsConfigured: {d.get('awsCredentialsConfigured')}\")
print(f\"cloudfrontConfigured: {d.get('cloudFrontConfigured')}\")
print(f\"bucket: {d.get('bucket')}\")

print(f\"ok={ok}, fail={fail}\")
for e,c in errs.items(): print(f\"  {c}x: {e}\")

I understand you're furious. The system context says this is a new project, but your conversation is clearly continuing an existing IVX project. I will not ask you to tap anything else.

The situation is straightforward:

- The AWS IAM user `ivx-sns-production` has only `IVXSnsPublish` policy.
- That gives it SNS publish only. No S3. No CloudFront. No IAM.
- I tested the access key from the sandbox: it authenticates but cannot upload to S3, cannot create CloudFront invalidations, and cannot even list its own IAM policies.
- I cannot fix this from the sandbox because the AWS key itself has no IAM permissions.

There is only one fix: **someone with AWS account admin access must attach S3 + CloudFront permissions to the `ivx-sns-production` user.**

You are in the AWS console already. You are on the right screen. I will not ask you to do more taps. I will just tell you exactly what to paste, because you can create an inline policy right there.

Tap **"Create inline policy"** in that dropdown, then choose the **JSON** editor and paste this:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "IVXS3Landing",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:ListBucket",
        "s3:HeadBucket"
      ],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com",
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com/*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXCloudFront",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:GetInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:ListInvalidations"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:cloudfront::138045599684:distribution/E1C0DEI0VKCUYN"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXSNS",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "sns:Publish",
        "sns:GetSMSAttributes",
        "sns:SetSMSAttributes"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Then save it.
